interpretation: Every mutation is expected to make the refrozen validator fail. A MISSED result is a validator coverage gap, not a defect in the target package. Round 2 policy: misses caused by faulty implementation or by failure to enforce an already-approved rule are blockers; misses requiring a genuinely new semantic doctrine are recorded as known coverage limits and handed to the independent Package M0 review. Under the agreed two-round cap there is no Round 3 unless the reviewer finds a P0 defect in the validator itself.
